subject: Postmortem: Reseller CPPO activation outage & action plan
messages:
From: Sarah Ng <sarah@cloudresell.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Cc: James Campbell <james.campbell@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: CPPO activation failed on customer account — logs attached

Hi Soojin / Ben,

Quick note from the field: we hit a hard failure when turning on the CPPO entitlement for AcmeRetail (acct #ACM-773). The reseller activation workflow returned a 502 on the final entitlement call and the buyer saw a billing placeholder but not the entitlement in their console. We've pulled logs and a runbook snapshot for the activation attempt.

Attaching: cloudresell-logs-0508.tgz and activation_runbook.pdf (short excerpts included in the ZIP).

Can Redwood confirm whether this is a seller-side validation error or an issue in the CPPO entitlement propagation to AWS? James — can you confirm whether AWS saw any internal errors for the PPOnotification in the same window?

This is high priority; the buyer is pausing the purchase until resolved. Next steps are to understand root cause and propose mitigation to unblock AcmeRetail.

Thanks,
Sarah Ng
Head of Partner Ops
CloudResell Inc

[Attachment: cloudresell-logs-0508.tgz (logs bundle, 4.2MB)]
[Attachment: activation_runbook.pdf (PDF, 380KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference>, Sarah Ng <sarah@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO activation failed on customer account — logs attached

Sarah — thanks for the quick heads up and for the log bundle. I pulled the trace and the 502 appears to come from our entitlement validation microservice when it receives an unexpected SKU mapping from the reseller payload. Initial hypothesis: a SKU alias mismatch combined with a race where the entitlement table wasn't fully propagated to the regional staging cache.

What I need from CloudResell: the exact SKU string shown on their request (you can redact internal IDs) and timestamps for the activation call. I'll run a cache invalidation/force-sync on our staging replica and re-run the entitlement job for the ACME activation window.

Priyom / Vanessa — looping you in to coordinate a short postmortem and an action plan for the reseller onboarding checklist so this doesn't recur. Suggested immediate actions:
- Force replica cache sync (Ben)
- Confirm SKU mapping table and add defensive aliasing (Priyom)
- Update reseller runbook to include SKU normalization step (Vanessa)

Can we target an internal triage call Monday to finalize the action plan?

Ben
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

[Inline snippets: error trace lines 304-318]

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 13 May 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO activation failed on customer account — logs attached

Putting time on the calendar for Monday, 13 May at 10:00 PT for a 45-minute triage (internal only) to confirm responsibilities. Agenda draft:
1) Review timeline of the failed activation
2) Confirm root cause (SKU alias vs cache propagation vs AWS webhook)
3) Short-term unblock for ACMERetail (manual entitlement + customer communication)
4) Long-term fixes and runbook updates
5) Communication plan to CloudResell and AWS PMs

Action owners suggested in-line: Ben (tech lead), Vanessa (partner enablement/runbook), Soojin (customer/reseller comms), Priyom (postmortem doc + follow-up tracker).

I'll prepare a Postmortem template and a consolidated action tracker after the call.

Thanks,
Priyom
Partner Ops Program Manager
Redwood Inference

[No attachments]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Ng <sarah@cloudresell.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>
Cc: James Campbell <james.campbell@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 13 May 2028 10:52:00 -0700
Subject: Postmortem and immediate remediation steps for AcmeRetail CPPO activation

Quick recap from today's triage (thanks everyone for joining). Findings:
- Root cause: SKU alias mismatch combined with a staging cache that had not received the latest SKU alias fold. The entitlement validation service returned a 502 when it couldn't find the normalized SKU.
- AWS involvement: James confirmed AWS received the CPPO notification but did not return an error — the window shows no API failures on the marketplace side.

Immediate remediation performed:
- Ben forced a cache resync and replayed the entitlement job for the affected window (completed 10:30 PT).
- We performed a manual entitlement grant for AcmeRetail to unblock billing and confirmed entitlement in their AWS console.
- CloudResell updated their activation payload to include the SKU alias mapping (temporary mitigation).

Open action items (owners / SLAs):
1) Priyom — produce the postmortem doc and a concise runbook change checklist by EOD Wednesday (2028-05-15).
2) Ben — add defensive SKU aliasing server-side and a test that fails the job faster with clearer logs (target: 2 weeks).
3) Vanessa — update reseller onboarding playbook to require SKU normalization and a pre-activation validation step (target: next partner enablement cohort).
4) Soojin — customer comms: send a short note to AcmeRetail confirming remediation and timeline (complete).

Sarah / CloudResell — please confirm the customer-facing note you want us to include and whether you'd like Redwood to send the initial “we resolved the entitlement” message or if you'd prefer to lead.

Thanks all — this was a good cross-team quick response, we should capture the learnings and add a test in our CI for PPOnotification flows.

Soojin Lee
Head of Partnerships, US
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: aws-ppo-evidence.zip (evidence bundle, 2.1MB)]

From: Sarah Ng <sarah@cloudresell.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.inference>
Cc: James Campbell <james.campbell@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Postmortem and immediate remediation steps for AcmeRetail CPPO activation

Thanks Soojin and team — appreciate the speedy remediation and clear action items. CloudResell prefers Redwood to send the initial customer message since it came from the entitlement side; we'll follow up with a reseller note after you send. Suggested customer message: short apology, confirmation of entitlement grant, explanation of the fix, and forward-looking guardrails to prevent recurrence.

We also want to request an evidence packet for our internal audit (SOC/partner ops) that shows the manual entitlement action and timeline — the aws-ppo-evidence.zip you attached looks good. Please confirm when the postmortem doc and final runbook checklist are available so we can update our reseller onboarding docs.

Sarah
Head of Partner Ops
CloudResell Inc
